lines.t: Is the true church - not one...
Is the true church - not one...
Who believes in The Messiah and obeys
His voice, in whom His spirit dwells,
Make up the True Church of His body...
No walls, only spirit and truth...
No walls, only spirit and truth...
Is the true church - not one...
Is the true church - not one...
No walls, only spirit and truth...
